notes: pursuit + defense-school is unreachable because pursuit requires diet >= 0.66 while defense-school requires diet <= 0.34.
pursuit + trail is unreachable: high-sense pursuit that passes social/size gates is captured by hunt-pack before trail; low-sense pursuit cannot satisfy trail sense > 0.44.
pursuit + cluster is unreachable because pursuit speed is >= 0.55 or > 0.72; the only overlap with cluster speed < 0.58 is preempted by hunt-pack when social/size gates pass, otherwise solitary wins.
pursuit + school is narrow but reachable when speed > 0.72 and 0.38 < sense <= 0.42 with sufficient sociality and size <= GROUP_MAX_SIZE_GENE.
ambusher + hunt-pack is reachable only near the speed boundary: ambusher speed < 0.55 and hunt-pack speed > 0.52.
scav + hunt-pack is reachable only near the diet boundary: scav is omnivore and hunt-pack needs diet > 0.62, so diet is mainly 0.62 < diet < 0.66.
filter + hunt-pack is unreachable because filter requires herbivore or diet < 0.50 while hunt-pack requires diet > 0.62.
socialStrategyFromGenes() priority is solitary by low sociality, solitary by size, hunt-pack, defense-school, trail, cluster, then school.
